correctness.rationale: Proved by exact disintegration of equal uniform marginals into residue fibers; exchangeability makes each fiber a symmetric bistochastic path-square matrix. Parity forces minimum long-edge mass 0 or 1. Imbalance between index classes modulo four forces maximal long-edge mass n or n−2. Explicit exact fractional matching gadgets attain every finite endpoint; integration yields both real-parameter formulas and mixing the endpoint copulas gives the complete interval. Exchangeable graph laws are involutions a.e. and odd fibers give the separate determinism obstruction. Standalone exact-fraction witness checker passed 2516 tests, complementing, not replacing, the universal proof.

The primary 2026 copula paper establishes geometric mass restrictions for special classes, not these extrema. General fractional matching theory gives a framework and half-integral cycle witnesses but does not state the integrated distance-dependent endpoints. The recent upper copula capacity paper likewise provides general capacity formulas, not the constrained conditional composition interval. Earlier single-distance capacity results imply the deterministic envelope only; that pre-existing implication is excluded from the novelty claim. Search non-detection does not establish absolute novelty.

value.rationale: The constrained probability of using the longer of two exactly allowed separations is an invariant with an immediate dependence-model interpretation. The complete, attained parameter interval displays distinct parity and modulo-four phase laws, and the construction distinguishes deterministic reversible couplings from genuinely randomized exchangeable ones. The single-distance deterministic bound is acknowledged as old; the new result is the full two-scale conditional allocation range. The exact formula is neither a mere substitution into a single-distance result nor a numerical table.
